help.title: Help
help.intro: This system helps aviation training organizations (ATOs) manage training operations, their Safety Management System (SMS), FSTD compliance, parts/tools, and personnel qualifications in accordance with EASA Part-ORA / Part-FCL and related regulations. Below, in the order of the left-hand menu, is an overview of what each module is for and how it's typically used.
help.quickStart1: First time here? Click "Register a new organization" on the login page and fill in the tenant name, email, and password. The registered account automatically becomes the tenant's OWNER, with full access to every module.
help.quickStart2: After logging in, start with "Organizations & Certificates" and create at least one Organization — almost all data in the system (FSTDs, inventory, role appointments, etc.) is attached to an Organization, so you can't enter other data without one.
help.quickStart3: For multi-person collaboration, have an OWNER/ADMIN account create additional logins under "Users & Permissions" and grant module access as needed (STAFF accounts are granted module access individually; OWNER/ADMIN accounts have full access to all modules by default).
help.permissionsAlertDesc: The left-hand menu only shows modules the current account has permission to access. If a module you expect is missing, ask an OWNER/ADMIN account in your organization to grant you access under "Users & Permissions".

organizations.label: Organizations & Certificates
organizations.body: Manage a training organization's basic information, operating certificates (AOC/ATO certificates, etc.) and their validity, and the "Complex Organization" determination (AMC1 ORA.GEN.200(b)). This determination affects certain compliance requirements elsewhere in the system (for example, whether a Safety Review Board is required). Also provides an "Annual Self-Review Checklist" feature that records each self-review item against GM2 ORA.GEN.200(c).

managementSystem.label: Management System SMS/QMS
managementSystem.intro: The core module for the Safety Management System (SMS) and compliance monitoring, covering several closed-loop processes:
managementSystem.orgRolesDesc: Appoint key roles such as the Safety Manager and the Compliance Monitoring Manager, and record the appointment document reference.
managementSystem.occurrenceDesc: Record mandatory/voluntary occurrence reports. Mandatory occurrence reports have a legal 72-hour reporting deadline (ORA.GEN.160); an overdue report automatically generates a reminder (see "Notifications" below).
managementSystem.riskDesc: Hazard registration → risk assessment (probability × severity matrix) → mitigation measures — the core closed loop of SMS.
managementSystem.policyDesc: Version-controlled; a new version must be re-signed by the Accountable Manager once it takes effect.
managementSystem.mocDesc: A significant change must complete a risk assessment before implementation, and its effectiveness must be verified afterward. Status flow: Draft → Risk Assessed → Implemented → Verified.
managementSystem.erpDesc: Version-controlled plans and annual emergency drill records.
managementSystem.spiDesc: Define measurable safety indicators and target values, and periodically record collected values.
managementSystem.srbDesc: Applies to "Complex Organizations"; records meeting minutes and tracks action items.
managementSystem.contractedDesc: Record outsourced/contracted operational activities (ORA.GEN.205) and whether they are included in the internal audit scope.
managementSystem.complianceDesc: Closed-loop tracking of audit plan → audit → findings → corrective actions (ORA.GEN.200).

fstds.label: FSTDs
fstds.intro: Compliance management for FSTDs/training devices — the broadest module, covering:
fstds.item1: Basic device information, periodic evaluation (qualification renewal), FCS capability matrix and training matrix (which tasks can be trained on the device)
fstds.item2: Discrepancy reporting and correction (3.3.7), plus "deferred defect" classification — an MMI defect that doesn't currently affect safe operation can be deferred, unblocking scheduling for related training tasks
fstds.item3: Preventive maintenance (PM) scheduling: configure checklist templates, log maintenance tasks, and dual-person review (the person who performed the task cannot review their own entry)
fstds.item4: QTG/MQTG document version management and quarterly rolling operation records (3.3.4)
fstds.item5: ESL equipment specification list, annual safety facility inspection (3.3.8), and monthly performance indicator logging
fstds.outro: Scheduling an FSTD automatically validates that the device is qualified for the training task and has no unresolved MMI defects.

inventory.label: Parts & Tools
inventory.body: Full lifecycle management of parts and tools, organized into 11 tabs on the page: parts inventory, tool calibration, purchase orders, failed parts, scrapping, parts demand, stocktaking, warehouse management (multi-warehouse/consignment), loans, parts inspection, and parts type configuration. Every operation that affects stock quantity (receiving/issuing/scrapping/stocktake adjustment/loan return) generates a traceable inventory transaction record. Scrapping and stocktake discrepancy adjustments both require a designated approver.

personnel.label: Personnel & Qualifications
personnel.body: Personnel records, qualification records (with expiry reminders), and instructor profiles (FI/TRI/SFI/Theoretical Instructor/Examiner). Personnel records are the foundational data for other modules such as "Role Appointments" and "PM task performer/reviewer" — it's recommended to enter these first.

courses.label: Courses
courses.body: Course and syllabus management, including course task requirements. A course must be approved (isApproved) before it can be formally used in student training records.

students.label: Student Records
students.body: Student records, course enrollment, and training record entries. Training records can be linked to course task requirements to track a student's progress.

bookings.label: Scheduling
bookings.body: Booking and scheduling of resources such as FSTDs and classrooms. When a booking is created, the system automatically validates that the resource is qualified for the training task and has no unresolved MMI defects; a booking that fails validation is rejected.

kiosk.label: Defect Report Kiosk
kiosk.body: A simplified discrepancy-reporting entry point open to anyone present (not restricted by module permissions — suited to a public terminal near the equipment), for quickly logging FSTD discrepancies. Data syncs to the discrepancy list in the FSTDs module.

isms.label: Information Security (ISMS)
isms.body: Information asset registration, information security risk assessment (likelihood × impact matrix) and mitigation measures, and the registration/containment/resolution workflow for information security incidents. This is a separate process from safety risk management in the Management System module — one covers operational safety, the other information security.

notifications.label: Notifications (bell icon in the header)
notifications.body: The system periodically (every hour by default) scans for mandatory occurrence reports that are overdue past the 72-hour legal deadline and notifies that organization's appointed Safety Manager. Unread notifications show a badge count on the bell icon; clicking the bell shows the recent notification list, and clicking a notification marks it as read. OWNER/ADMIN accounts can also click "Check overdue reminders now" to trigger a scan immediately instead of waiting for the next hourly run.
notifications.note: Note: this reminder mechanism currently only covers "overdue occurrence reports" — the same pattern can later be extended to other scenarios such as PM tasks, ERP drills, or qualification expiry.

users.label: Users & Permissions (OWNER/ADMIN only)
users.body: Manage login accounts under this tenant. The OWNER account is created automatically at registration, has full access to all modules, and cannot be modified or disabled. ADMIN and STAFF accounts are created by OWNER/ADMIN, but only OWNER can create or modify ADMIN accounts. STAFF accounts need module access granted individually. Passwords for other accounts can also be reset and accounts disabled here.

auditLogs.label: Audit Trail (OWNER/ADMIN only)
auditLogs.body: A unified system-wide audit log (ORA.GEN.220) recording who performed every create/update/status-change operation, when, and a before/after data snapshot — filterable by entity type/ID for compliance traceability of "who changed what, when". Sensitive information such as passwords never appears in the audit log.

menuMissing.label: Why is a module missing from the left-hand menu?
menuMissing.body: Menu items are shown dynamically based on account permissions. Ask your organization's OWNER/ADMIN account to grant you access to that module under "Users & Permissions".

bookingBlocked.label: Why does the system block my booking?
bookingBlocked.body: Common causes: the selected FSTD isn't qualified for the training task (not recorded in the training matrix), or the device has an unresolved MMI defect that hasn't been deferred. Check the device's qualifications and defect status in the FSTDs module.

notificationNotReceived.label: Why didn't the expected recipient get a notification?
notificationNotReceived.body: In-app notifications require the recipient's login account to be linked to their Personnel record; SMS notifications require a phone number on that Personnel record and a real SMS provider configured by the system administrator at deployment. If neither is configured, the system only logs the notification content on the server — it is not actually delivered.
